# pve_vm_disk_move (Action)

Move a VM disk to another storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_disk_move" "example" {
  config {
  disk = "ide0"
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_disk_move.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `bwlimit` (Number) Override I/O bandwidth limit (in KiB/s). (default: move limit from datacenter or storage config)
- `delete` (Boolean) Delete the original disk after successful copy. By default the original disk is kept as unused disk. (default: 0)
- `digest` (String) Prevent changes if current configuration file has different SHA1 digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `format` (String) Target disk format. Only used when moving to a different storage. If the target storage does not support the format, the storage's default format is used instead. One of: `raw`, `qcow2`, `vmdk`.
- `storage` (String) Target storage.
- `target_digest` (String) Prevent changes if the current config file of the target VM has a different SHA1 digest. This can be used to detect concurrent modifications.
- `target_disk` (String) The config key the disk will be moved to on the target VM (for example, ide0 or scsi1). Default is the source disk key.
